title: facelis retusa
intro: Facelis retusa, commonly known as Mexican daisy or Spanish daisy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Facelis retusa include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, and it is also used to treat various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
